import json, subprocess

def act(turn_deg, move_m):
    res = subprocess.run(['python3', '/app/act.py', json.dumps({'turn_deg': turn_deg, 'move_m': move_m})], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return json.loads(res.stdout)

# Current pose: (0.5, 3.3), heading 180 (-y). (obs 34)
# Let's turn 90 to face 270 (-x) -> obs 35
out35 = act(90, 0)
print('obs 35:', out35['frame'], out35['status'], out35.get('collision'))

# Turn 90 to face 0 (+y) -> obs 36
out36 = act(90, 0)
print('obs 36:', out36['frame'], out36['status'], out36.get('collision'))

# Move forward 0.5 along heading 0 -> pose (0.5, 3.8) -> obs 37
out37 = act(0, 0.5)
print('obs 37:', out37['frame'], out37['status'], out37.get('collision'))

# Turn right 90 to face 90 (+x) -> obs 38 (looking at Chair 2 and sofa)
out38 = act(90, 0)
print('obs 38:', out38['frame'], out38['status'], out38.get('collision'))

# Move forward 0.5 along heading 90 -> pose (1.0, 3.8) -> obs 39
out39 = act(0, 0.5)
print('obs 39:', out39['frame'], out39['status'], out39.get('collision'))

# Turn right 90 to face 180 (-y) -> obs 40 (checkpoint 40!)
out40 = act(90, 0)
print('obs 40:', out40['frame'], out40['status'], out40.get('collision'))
"
